goals.0: Parts of a letter: Absender, Betreff, Frist
goals.1: Polite instructions: Bitte reichen Sie … ein
grammar.0.title: Parts of a letter
grammar.0.note: In an official letter the date and the Frist are the most important. Missing a Frist can void your application — if in doubt, phone or email to let them know.
grammar.1.title: Polite instructions (in letters)
grammar.1.note: Separable verbs: einreichen → reichen Sie … ein; mitteilen → teilen Sie mit; einhalten → halten … ein.
grammar.1.rows.2.1: If you do not meet the deadline, your application may be rejected.
grammar.1.rows.3.1: You can lodge an objection against this decision.
grammar.2.title: Genitiv: whose? (recognition only)
grammar.2.note: Genitiv = “of” (whose?): der Antrag des Mannes = the man's application. For m/n nouns -s or -es is added. It is common in official letters; in speech people often say „von + Dativ“ (der Antrag von meinem Bruder).
